````css
    flex: 1;
    padding: 8px 4px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
#main-panel .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
#main-panel .tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent-red); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-red); }
#main-panel .drawer-minimize-btn {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--text-dim);
}
#main-panel .drawer-minimize-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-red); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }
#main-panel .drawer-hide-btn {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--text-dim);
}
#main-panel .drawer-hide-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-red); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

/* ── Hidden Drawer (slides below the viewport) ── */
#drawer-container.hidden {
    transform: translateY(105%);
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.28s ease, visibility 0s linear 0.28s;
}
#drawer-container {
    will-change: transform;
    transition: transform 0.28s ease, visibility 0s linear;
}
#drawer-container::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-red), transparent);
    opacity: 0.65;
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* Floating show button (reopens the hidden drawer) */
#drawer-show-btn {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 11;
    padding: 6px 18px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
#drawer-show-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); }

/* ── Tab Content Panels ── */
#main-panel .tab-content {
    display: none;
    overflow-y: auto;
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 0;
}
#main-panel .tab-content.active { display: block; }

/* ── Sub-tabs (DATA > INTELLIGENCE|DNA|LOGS, CONFIG > WORLD|SPECIES|SETTINGS) ── */
#main-panel .sub-tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 0 8px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
#main-panel .sub-tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
#main-panel .sub-tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); }
#main-panel .sub-tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent-blue); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-blue); }
#main-panel .sub-tab-content { display: none; padding: 4px 0; }
#main-panel .sub-tab-content.active { display: block; }


/* ── Minimized Drawer ── */
#drawer-container.minimized {
    max-height: none;
}
#drawer-container.minimized .tab-content {
    display: none !important;
}
#drawer-container.minimized #main-panel .tabs {
    border-bottom: none;
}

/* ── Category Filter (World tab) ── */
.category-filter-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.cat-tab {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.cat-tab:hover { border-color: var(--text-secondary); color: var(--text-secondary); }
/* Category filter buttons carry their own spectrum colour (dull off, bright on) */
.cat-tab { color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 80% 72% / 0.7); border-color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 70% 55% / 0.35); }
.cat-tab.active { border-color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 95% 64%); color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 95% 72%); background: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 85% 55% / 0.12); }

/* ── Law Icon Grid (World tab) ── */
#law-grid.hidden { display: none !important; }

.law-icon-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(32px, 1fr));
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 6px;
}
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    min-height: 28px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
}
/* Category colour visible even when the law is off (bright when active) */
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 80% 72% / 0.55); border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 65% 50% / 0.30); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 70% 50% / 0.05); }
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 60% / 0.25); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 85%); }

/* ── World Sliders ── */
.world-sliders {
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.world-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 3px 0;
}
.world-slider-row label {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    min-width: 80px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.world-slider-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 3px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
}
.world-slider-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-red);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.world-slider-row .slider-value {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--accent-red);
    min-width: 30px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ── Species Tab ── */
.species-controls-header {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
#add-species-btn {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-green);
    color: var(--accent-green);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    cursor: pointer;
}
#add-species-btn:hover { background: rgba(74,255,138,0.1); }
#remove-species-btn {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
    color: var(--accent-red);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    cursor: pointer;
}
#remove-species-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,80,80,0.1); }
.species-remove {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    line-height: 1;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size: 9px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.species-remove:hover { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); }
.species-remove.disabled { opacity: 0.25; pointer-events: none; }

#species-list { padding: 4px; }
.species-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}
.species-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.species-card.selected { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); }
.species-swatch { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; }
.species-name { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: 1px; flex: 1; }
.species-count { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-dim); }

/* ── Accordion ── */
.main-accordion { padding: 4px; }
.accordion-section {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.accordion-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.accordion-header:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: var(--text-primary); }
.accordion-header .arrow { transition: transform 0.2s; font-size: 7px; }
.accordion-section.open .accordion-header .arrow { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.accordion-section.open .accordion-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.accordion-body { display: none; padding: 4px 8px; }
.accordion-section.open .accordion-body { display: block; }

/* ── Sub-group accordions (grouped world params) ── */
.sub-accordion-section {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border-radius: 3px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.sub-accordion-section.open .sub-accordion-body { display: block; }
.sub-accordion-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    opacity: 0.75;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.sub-accordion-header:hover { opacity: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.sub-accordion-header .arrow { transition: transform 0.2s; font-size: 7px; }
.sub-accordion-section.open .sub-accordion-header .arrow { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.sub-accordion-body { display: none; padding: 2px 4px 4px; }
.accordion-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 2px 0;
}
.accordion-slider-row label {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    min-width: 60px;
}
.accordion-slider-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 2px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
}
.accordion-slider-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.accordion-slider-row .slider-val {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--accent-blue);
    min-width: 28px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ── Enhanced Slider Control (src/ui/sliderControl.js) ── */
.sc-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 2px 0;
    width: 100%;
}
.sc-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    width: 100%;
}
.sc-label {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    min-width: 92px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.sc-dna .sc-label {
    min-width: 104px;
}
.sc-bound {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    height: 14px;
    line-height: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-width: 24px;
    text-align: center;
}
.sc-bound:hover {
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    border-color: var(--accent-gold);
}
.sc-zoomed .sc-bound {
    color: var(--accent-orange);
    border-color: var(--accent-orange);
}
.sc-input {
    flex: 1;
    height: 2px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 40px;
}
.sc-input::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.sc-input::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.sc-value {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--accent-blue);
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sc-mode {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    height: 14px;
    line-height: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sc-mode.is-log {
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    border-color: var(--accent-gold);
}
.sc-mode:disabled {
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: default;
}
.sc-zoom {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    height: 14px;
    line-height: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-width: 18px;
}
.sc-zoom.is-zoomed {
    color: var(--accent-orange);
    border-color: var(--accent-orange);
}
.sc-edit {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-gold);
    border-radius: 3px;
    width: 44px;
    padding: 0 2px;
    height: 14px;
}
.sc-zoombar {
    position: relative;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--border);
    opacity: 0.5;
    border-radius: 1px;
}
.sc-zoombar-fill {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    border-radius: 1px;
    transition: left 120ms ease, width 120ms ease;
}
.sc-zoomed .sc-zoombar {
    opacity: 1;
}
.sc-zoomed .sc-zoombar-fill {
    background: var(--accent-orange);
}

/* ── DNA Analytics ── */
#dna-analytics { padding: 6px 8px; }
.analytics-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.analytics-card {
    flex: 1;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 6px;
}
.analytics-card h4 {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.bar-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.bar-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-dim); min-width: 30px; }
.bar-track { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
.bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.3s ease; }
.bar-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-dim); min-width: 24px; text-align: right; }

/* ── DNA Fingerprint Grid ── */
.dna-fingerprint-grid { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.fingerprint-species { flex: 1; min-width: 100px; }
.fingerprint-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.fingerprint-bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1px; height: 40px; }
.fp-bar { width: 3px; min-height: 1px; border-radius: 1px; }

/* ── Genetic Diversity Table ── */
.diversity-metrics { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; }
.diversity-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.diversity-table th { color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: left; padding: 2px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.diversity-table td { padding: 2px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.het-bar-track { display: inline-block; width: 60px; height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; vertical-align: middle; }
.het-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.3s ease; }
.het-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-left: 4px; }



/* ── Chart sections ── */
#dna-charts { padding: 0 8px 8px; }
.chart-section { margin-top: 8px; }
.chart-title {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--accent-red);
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#pop-line-graph, #mass-nrg-scatter {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100px;
    background: #000;
    border: 1px solid #222;
    display: block;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
}
#mass-nrg-scatter { height: 120px; }

/* ── LOG Panel ── */
#narrative-log { padding: 4px 8px; max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; }
.log-entry {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    padding: 3px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── Settings/Laws Panel ── */
#laws-panel { padding: 4px; }
.law-section {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.law-section-header {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.law-grid-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 4px;
}
.law-btn {
    padding: 4px 2px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    text-align: center;
}
.law-btn:hover { border-color: var(--text-secondary); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.law-btn.active { color: #000; font-weight: bold; }

/* ── Scrollbar ── */
#main-panel .tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; }
#main-panel .tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
#main-panel .tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 2px; }


/* ── Law Info Module (above law grid) ──────────────────────── */
.law-info-module {
  width: 100%;
  height: 96px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: rgba(8, 8, 16, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.law-info-module.hidden { display: none; }
.law-info-module .info-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 100%;
}
.law-info-module .info-icon {
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 32px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.law-info-module .info-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  font-weight: bold;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: rgba(8, 8, 16, 0.96);
  padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-title {
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.law-info-module .info-category {
  font-size: 9px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  opacity: 0.8;
}
.law-info-module .info-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 0 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
.law-info-module .info-hint {
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-explanation {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-system {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  font-size: 8px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  font-style: italic;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle .toggle-track {
  width: 24px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.on .toggle-track {
  background: var(--accent-green);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.off .toggle-track {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle .toggle-knob {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  transition: left 0.2s;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.on .toggle-knob {
  left: 13px;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.off .toggle-knob {
  left: 1px;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle .toggle-label {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.on .toggle-label {
  color: var(--accent-green);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.off .toggle-label {
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

/* ── Chaos Menu ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.chaos-menu {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.chaos-menu-content {
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.97);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px;
  min-width: 240px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
}
.chaos-menu-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.chaos-menu-cats {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.chaos-cat-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.chaos-cat-row:hover { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.1); }
.chaos-cat-row input[type="checkbox"] {
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
}
.chaos-menu-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.chaos-btn-action {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 60px;
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.1);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  padding: 6px 8px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.chaos-btn-action:hover {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.25);
}

/* ── View Mode Toggle ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.view-mode-toggle {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.view-mode-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--text);
}
.view-mode-toggle.word-mode {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}
.view-mode-toggle.active {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  background: rgba(74,158,255,0.10);
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
}
.law-mode-icon {
  min-width: 22px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.view-mode-toggle.law-mode-abc {
  margin-left: 0;
}

/* Word-mode law grid items */
.sq-toggle-word {
  width: auto !important;
  height: 24px !important;
  padding: 0 6px;
  gap: 4px;
  justify-content: flex-start !important;
  font-size: 9px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sq-toggle-word .tog-icon {
  font-size: 11px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sq-toggle-word .tog-name {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
#law-grid.word-mode {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 5px 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  text-align: left;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn .tog-icon {
  font-size: 11px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn .tog-name {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
/* Category-coloured icons in list mode (dim when inactive, bright when active) */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn .tog-icon { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 80% 74%); }
/* Active list-mode laws get the full spectrum accent (matches icon mode) */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 60% / 0.2); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 85%); }
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 65% 50% / 0.28); }
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  #law-grid.word-mode { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    #top-toolbar .sq-btn { width: 24px; height: 20px; font-size: 9px; }
    .toolbar-center { gap: 6px; }
    .hud-item { font-size: 7px; }
    .law-icon-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(26px, 1fr)); }
    .law-grid-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

/* ── DNA Tab Expanded Charts ── */

#dna-charts {
    padding: 6px;
}

.chart-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chart-row .chart-section {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.chart-section {
    background: #0a0a0f;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a2a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chart-title {
    font-size: 7px;
    color: #555;
    margin: 0 0 3px 0;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.chart-section canvas {
    width: 100%;
    height: 80px;
    display: block;
}

.dna-section-title {
    font-size: 8px;
    color: #888;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    margin: 4px 0;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2a;
}

/* ── DNA Analytics Stats ── */

.dna-stat-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 1px 0;
    font-size: 7px;
}

.dna-stat-label {
    width: 50px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: #888;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.dna-stat-bar-bg {
    flex: 1;
    height: 8px;
    background: #111;
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.dna-stat-bar {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: width 0.3s;
}

.dna-stat-val {
    width: 50px;
    text-align: right;
    color: #aaa;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Tap-to-copy diagnostic banners */
[data-copyable]::after {
    content: ' ⧉ tap to copy';
    opacity: 0.7;
    font-weight: normal;
}
[data-copyable]:active {
    filter: brightness(1.4);
}

/* Settings panel */
.setting-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
.setting-label {
    flex: 0 0 45%;
    font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    color: #9ab;
}
#cam-reset {
    margin: 6px 0;
}

/* ── v4: World Intelligence Panel ── */
.world-intel {
  margin-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 10px;
}
.intel-header {
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.intel-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.intel-cell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.intel-label {
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.intel-value {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: var(--accent-green);
}
.intel-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}
.intel-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.intel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-purple); color: var(--accent-purple); }
.intel-btn.recording { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); }
#intel-scrub {
  flex: 1;
  accent-color: var(--accent-purple);
}
.intel-log {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  white-space: pre-line;
  max-height: 64px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* ── v4: Debug overlay ── */
.vepa-debug {
  position: fixed;
  top: 4px;
  left: 4px;
  z-index: 99999;
  width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 8px));
  background: rgba(10, 10, 14, 0.92);
  border: 1px solid #555;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #ddd;
}
.vepa-debug.hidden { display: none; }
.vepa-debug-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #444;
}
.vepa-debug-dot { color: #4aff8a; font-size: 10px; }
.vepa-debug-title { color: #4aff8a; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.vepa-debug-version { color: #9adc9a; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.vepa-debug-count { color: #ffd700; font-weight: bold; }
.vepa-debug-stats {
  flex: 1;
  color: #888;
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.vepa-debug-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid #666;
  color: #ccc;
  font: 10px var(--font-mono);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.vepa-debug-btn:hover { border-color: #4aff8a; color: #4aff8a; }
.vepa-debug-btn.dbg-copied { color: #060; background: #4aff8a; border-color: #4aff8a; }
.vepa-debug-body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  max-height: 45vh;
  overflow: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-all;
}
.vepa-debug-body .dbg-error { color: #ff6a6a; }
.vepa-debug-body .dbg-warn  { color: #ffd700; }
.vepa-debug-body .dbg-info  { color: #9adc9a; }

/* ============================================================
   VEPA4 — PIZZAZ (atmosphere & micro-interactions)
   Added 2026-08-02
   ============================================================ */

/* ── CRT scanline texture over the simulation viewport ── */
#app::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 5;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028) 0px,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 3px
    );
}

/* ── Top toolbar: drop shadow + animated accent sheen ── */
#top-toolbar {
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.15), 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}
#top-toolbar::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: -1px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-blue) 35%, var(--accent-red) 65%, transparent);
    opacity: 0.5;
    animation: toolbar-sheen 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes toolbar-sheen {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; }
    50% { opacity: 0.75; }
}

/* ── Toolbar buttons: hover glow + pulse on active ── */
#top-toolbar .sq-btn:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.35);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}
#top-toolbar .sq-btn:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.94); }
#top-toolbar .sq-btn.active {
    animation: pulse-orange 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse-orange {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 138, 74, 0.25); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255, 138, 74, 0.55); }
}
#chaos-btn:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 74, 74, 0.4);
}

/* ── Tab bar: glowing active underline ── */
#main-panel .tab-btn.active {
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 74, 74, 0.65);
}
#main-panel .tab-btn:hover { text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); }

/* ── HUD: color-coded live stats ── */
.hud-fps {
    color: var(--accent-green);
    text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(74, 255, 138, 0.5);
}
.hud-particles {
    color: var(--accent-blue);
    text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.5);
}
.hud-species {
    color: var(--accent-purple);
    text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(180, 74, 255, 0.5);
}
.hud-tick { color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* ── Law toggles: gentle glow pulse on active ── */
.law-btn.active.physics,
.law-btn.active.biology,
.law-btn.active.chemistry,
.law-btn.active.thermodynamics,
.law-btn.active.metaphysics {
    animation: law-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes law-pulse {
    0%, 100% { filter: brightness(1); }
    50% { filter: brightness(1.25); }
}

/* ── Drawer: subtle red glow above the tab strip ── */
#main-panel .drawer-minimize-btn,
#main-panel .drawer-hide-btn {
    font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── Chaos Multiplex ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#multiplex-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  display: none;
  padding: 10px;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(20,20,35,0.9), rgba(5,5,12,0.97));
}
#multiplex-overlay.active { display: flex; }
#multiplex-grid {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.shard-cell {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #07070d;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.shard-cell::after {
  content: attr(data-shard-label);
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  left: 8px;
  z-index: 2;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
  pointer-events: none;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000;
}
.shard-cell.selected {
  border-color: var(--accent-red);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,74,74,0.55), inset 0 0 22px rgba(255,74,74,0.10);
}
.shard-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  touch-action: none;
  cursor: crosshair;
}

/* Bottom multiplex controls bar (all settings live in the setup screen) */
#multiplex-drawer {
  z-index: 45;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
#multiplex-drawer.hidden { display: none; }

/* Minimized: slim strip — icon-only iterate button stays visible */
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-strip {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 4px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-strip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); }
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-chevron {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
#multiplex-drawer.expanded .mpx-strip { display: none; }

/* Expanded body */
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-body {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 340px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 18px rgba(255,74,74,0.18);
}
#multiplex-drawer.expanded .mpx-body { display: flex; }
.mpx-body-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.mpx-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.mpx-stat {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.mpx-btn {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-icon {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.mpx-action {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.10);
  border-color: rgba(255,74,74,0.5);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-action:hover { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.22); }
.mpx-danger { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.16); }

/* ── Live settings inside the right-edge drawer ── */
.mpx-settings {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 8px 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.mpx-settings-title {
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.mpx-set-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-set-label { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.mpx-set-value {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 8px;
}
.mpx-set-row input[type="range"] {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
  height: 12px;
}
.mpx-checks { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-left: auto; }
.mpx-check {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-check input { accent-color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-num {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
}
.mpx-num input {
  width: 30px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  padding: 2px 3px;
}
.mpx-set-row select {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}

/* ── Multiplex drawer tabs + FIT panel (v4.6.24) ── */
.mpx-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.mpx-tab {
  flex: 1;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-tab:hover { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(255,74,74,0.5); }
.mpx-tab.active {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.14);
  border-color: var(--accent-red);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-panel { display: none; }
.mpx-panel.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

/* Fitness metric rows */
.mpx-fit-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-fit-label {
  flex: 0 0 52px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.mpx-fit-row input[type="range"] {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
  height: 12px;
}
.mpx-fit-pct {
  flex: 0 0 30px;
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 8px;
}
.mpx-mode {
  flex: 0 0 32px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 2px 0;
}
.mpx-mode:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-fit-title {
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.mpx-fit-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  max-height: 180px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 4px;
}
.mpx-fit-shard {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 2px 4px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mpx-fit-shard:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
.mpx-fit-shard.selected {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.14);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-fit-shard span { color: var(--text-primary); }

/* ── Multiplex metrics top drawer ── */
#mpx-metrics {
  z-index: 60;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#mpx-metrics > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.mpx-metrics-toggle {
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,74,74,0.5);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-metrics-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.16); }
.mpx-metrics-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  max-width: 92vw;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,74,74,0.4);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
#mpx-metrics.collapsed .mpx-metrics-body { display: none; }
.mpx-metrics-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  justify-content: center;
}
.mpx-metric-chip {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-metric-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-metric-chip.selected {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.16);
  border-color: var(--accent-red);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-metrics-stats {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Chaos Multiplex settings modal */
#chaos-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}
#chaos-modal.open { display: flex; }
.chaos-modal-panel {
  width: 400px;
  max-width: 94vw;
  max-height: 92vh;
  overflow: auto;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.98);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 26px rgba(255,74,74,0.22);
}
.chaos-modal-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.chaos-modal-sub {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.chaos-modal-section {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 12px 0;
}
.chaos-modal-label {
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.chaos-grid-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.chaos-grid-row label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 10px;
}
.chaos-grid-row input[type="number"] {
  width: 52px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 5px 6px;
}
.chaos-grid-row input[type="number"]:focus { border-color: var(--accent-red); outline: none; }
.chaos-grid-count {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.chaos-check,
.chaos-radio {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 0;
}
.chaos-check input[type="checkbox"],
.chaos-radio input[type="radio"] {
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
}
.chaos-check:hover,
.chaos-radio:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
#mpx-variation {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.chaos-variation-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
#mpx-variation-value { color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-modal-fit {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.chaos-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.chaos-modal-actions .mpx-action { flex: 1; }

/* ── Law category rows (one row per law type) ─────────────────── */
.law-icon-grid,
#law-grid.word-mode { display: block; padding: 4px; }
.law-cat-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 4px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}
.law-cat-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.law-cat-label {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  opacity: 0.75;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.law-cat-row .sq-toggle {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  flex: 0 0 30px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-cat-row .law-btn {
  width: auto;
  flex: 1 1 82px;
}
#law-grid.hidden { display: none; }

/* ── Dull spectrum tint when a law is OFF (icon mode) ── */
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 65% 50% / 0.30); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 80% 74% / 0.55); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 70% 50% / 0.05); }

/* ── Dull spectrum tint when a law is OFF (list mode) ── */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 80% 74% / 0.60); }
/* Active list-mode icons inherit the bright button colour */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn.active .tog-icon { color: inherit; }

/* ── Exclusive view-mode group ── */
.view-mode-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; margin-left: auto; }
.view-mode-group .view-mode-toggle { margin-left: 0; }
.view-mode-toggle.law-mode-icon { min-width: 24px; text-align: center; }

/* ── Law set bar (save / load presets) ── */
.law-set-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: relative;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.law-set-btn {
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}
.law-set-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-blue); color: var(--accent-blue); }
.law-set-selector {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: left;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 8px;
}
.law-set-selector:hover { border-color: var(--accent-blue); color: var(--accent-gold); }
.law-set-icon {
  width: 26px;
  padding: 3px 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  flex: none;
}
.law-set-dropdown {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  left: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  top: calc(100% - 4px);
  z-index: 50;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.99);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue);
  border-radius: 4px;
  max-height: 40vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}
.law-set-dropdown.open { display: block; }
.law-set-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.12s;
}
.law-set-row:hover { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.12); }
.law-set-row.selected { background: rgba(255,215,0,0.10); }
.law-set-check {
  width: 10px;
  flex: none;
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}
.law-set-mini-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 1px;
}
.law-set-mini-icon {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  flex: 0 0 13px;
  font-size: 8px;
  line-height: 13px;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 2px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
}
.law-set-mini-icon { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 90% 80% / 0.95); border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 70% 55% / 0.5); }
.law-set-row-name {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.law-set-editor {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  align-items: center;
  flex: 1 1 100%;
}
.law-set-editor.hidden { display: none; }
.law-set-editor input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 3px 6px;
}
.law-set-editor button {
  background: rgba(74,158,255,0.12);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.law-set-editor button:hover { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.25); }

/* ── Compact category rows (labels removed — filters carry the colour) ── */
.law-cat-label { display: none; }
.law-cat-row {
  padding: 2px 0;
  gap: 2px;
  border-bottom: none;
}

/* ── EM-spectrum law rainbow — all 8 categories, hue-driven ── */
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 65% 50% / 0.30); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 80% 74% / 0.55); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 70% 50% / 0.05); }
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 60% / 0.25); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 85%); }
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 80% 74% / 0.60); }
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 85% 60% / 0.2); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 95% 85%); }
.law-set-mini-icon { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 90% 80% / 0.95); border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) 70% 55% / 0.5); }

/* ── Multiplex long-press tooltips (v4.6.28) ── */
#mpx-tooltip {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 130;
  max-width: 280px;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.97);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 18px rgba(255,74,74,0.25);
}
#mpx-tooltip.hidden { display: none; }
.mpx-tip-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.mpx-tip-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.mpx-tip-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.mpx-tip-guide,
.mpx-tip-close {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mpx-tip-guide:hover,
.mpx-tip-close:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-tip-hint {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.mpx-tip-expl {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ? help button in the controls drawer */
.mpx-header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.mpx-help-btn {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border-color: rgba(255,74,74,0.5);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}

/* ── Full-screen multiplex guide (v4.6.28) ── */
#mpx-help-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 120;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78);
  padding: 16px;
}
#mpx-help-overlay.hidden { display: none; }
.mpx-help-panel {
  width: 560px;
  max-width: 96vw;
  max-height: 92vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.98);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), 0 0 26px rgba(255,74,74,0.22);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.mpx-help-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.mpx-help-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
}
.mpx-help-sub {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 10px 16px 0;
}
.mpx-help-sections {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 8px 16px 16px;
}
.mpx-help-section { margin-top: 12px; }
.mpx-help-section-label {
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.mpx-help-item {
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
}
.mpx-help-item-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.mpx-help-item-hint {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.mpx-help-item-expl {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 8px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-top: 3px;
}

/* ============================================================
   Bold UI scale-up — 2× toolbar icons, 2-row law tiles,
   enlarged slider controls (2026-08-11)
   ============================================================ */

/* ── Top toolbar: ~2× buttons + icons ── */
#top-toolbar {
    height: 64px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    gap: 6px;
}
#top-toolbar .sq-btn {
    width: 56px;
    height: 48px;
    font-size: 22px;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 2px);
}
#chaos-btn:hover,
#chaos-multiplex-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--accent-red);
    background: rgba(255, 70, 70, 0.1);
}
.toolbar-center { gap: 14px; }
.hud-item { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1px; }

/* ── Law tiles: ~2× with icon + name rows ── */
.law-cat-row {
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 4px;
}
.law-cat-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.law-cat-row .sq-toggle {
    width: auto;
    height: 58px;
    flex: 1 1 calc(12.5% - 6px);
    min-width: 56px;
    max-width: 78px;
    font-size: 22px;
    aspect-ratio: auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 5px 2px 4px;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 2px);
}
.law-cat-row .sq-toggle .tog-icon {
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 1;
}
.law-cat-row .sq-toggle .tog-name {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    line-height: 1;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Word mode: 2 cols, bigger tiles */
#law-grid.word-mode {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-cat-row .law-btn {
    flex: 1 1 170px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
````

````js
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  PARTICLE_STRIDE, MAX_PARTICLES, STRIDE_INDEXES as S, DNA_RANGES, LAW_INDEXES,
} from '../../src/constants.js';
import { createParticleBuffer } from '../../src/state/particleBuffer.js';
import { createLawState, set, isSet } from '../../src/state/lawState.js';
import { createDNABuffer, loadDefaults } from '../../src/dna/dnaBuffer.js';
import { solve } from '../../src/physics/solver.js';
import { runtimeConfig } from '../../src/state/runtimeConfig.js';

const WORLD = 2000;
const DT = 0.25;
const rng = () => 0.5;

// Deterministic LCG so the ENTR jitter test is reproducible.
function lcg(seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return s / 4294967296;
  };
}

function makeWorld(count, setup) {
  const buf = createParticleBuffer(MAX_PARTICLES, PARTICLE_STRIDE);
  const view = buf.view;
  const dna = createDNABuffer();
  loadDefaults(dna, DNA_RANGES);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const b = i * PARTICLE_STRIDE;
    view[b + S.POS_X] = 1000;
    view[b + S.POS_Y] = 1000;
    view[b + S.POS_Z] = 1000;
    view[b + S.VEL_X] = 0; view[b + S.VEL_Y] = 0; view[b + S.VEL_Z] = 0;
    view[b + S.MASS] = 1.5;
    view[b + S.SPECIES_ID] = 0;
    view[b + S.DEAD] = 0;
    view[b + S.AGE] = 0;
    view[b + S.ENERGY] = 100;
    view[b + S.SIGNAL] = 0;
    view[b + S.HUNGER] = 0;
    view[b + S.ARMOR] = 0;
    view[b + S.TEMPERATURE] = 0;
    view[b + S.RADIUS] = 0.6;
    view[b + S.BOND_PARTNER_1] = -1;
    for (let d = 0; d < 42; d++) {
      const r = DNA_RANGES[d] || { min: -1, max: 1 };
      view[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + d] = r.default ?? 0;
    }
    if (setup) setup(view, dna, b, i);
  }
  return { view, dna };
}

describe('Batch 01 — GRAV / DRAG / ENTR / WRAP (indices 0-3)', () => {
  it('GRAV: particles accelerate toward each other and separation decreases', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = i === 0 ? 995 : 1005;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.GRAV);
    expect(isSet(laws, LAW_INDEXES.GRAV)).toBe(true);
    const d0 = view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.POS_X] - view[S.POS_X];
    for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    const d1 = view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.POS_X] - view[S.POS_X];
    expect(d1).toBeLessThan(d0);
    expect(view[S.VEL_X]).toBeGreaterThan(0);              // i pulled toward j (+x)
    expect(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.VEL_X]).toBeLessThan(0); // j pulled toward i (-x)
  });

  it('GRAV: FORCE DNA is pairwise — both positive amplify, both negative repel, opposite cancel', () => {
    const run = (f0, f1) => {
      const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
        v[b + S.POS_X] = i === 0 ? 995 : 1005;
        v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 0] = i === 0 ? f0 : f1; // FORCE
      });
      const laws = createLawState();
      set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.GRAV);
      for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
      return view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.POS_X] - view[S.POS_X]; // separation
    };
    const plain = run(0, 0);              // no FORCE → plain attraction
    expect(run(100, 100)).toBeLessThan(plain); // both positive → multiply pull
    expect(run(-100, -100)).toBeGreaterThan(10); // both negative → multiply negatively (repel)
    expect(run(100, -100)).toBeCloseTo(10, 5);   // opposite signs → cancel (neutral)
  });

  it('GRAV gate: with GRAV off, resting particles never move', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = i === 0 ? 995 : 1005;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    for (let t = 0; t < 20; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.VEL_X]).toBe(0);
    expect(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.VEL_X]).toBe(0);
    expect(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.POS_X] - view[S.POS_X]).toBeCloseTo(10, 5);
  });

  it('DRAG: velocity decays over time (viscosity damping)', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.VEL_X] = 5;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.DRAG);
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    const v0 = view[S.VEL_X];
    for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(Math.abs(view[S.VEL_X])).toBeLessThan(Math.abs(v0));
    expect(view[S.VEL_X]).toBeGreaterThan(0); // decays, does not reverse
  });

  it('DRAG gate: without DRAG, velocity is preserved exactly', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.VEL_X] = 5;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.VEL_X]).toBeCloseTo(5, 5);
  });

  it('ENTR: jitter injects random kinetic energy (velocity leaves zero)', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 3] = 5; // JITTER
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.ENTR);
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    const prng = lcg(12345);
    for (let t = 0; t < 80; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, prng);
    const speed = Math.hypot(view[S.VEL_X], view[S.VEL_Y], view[S.VEL_Z]);
    expect(speed).toBeGreaterThan(0.2);
  });

  it('ENTR gate: without ENTR, no force means velocity stays zero', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 3] = 5;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    const prng = lcg(12345);
    for (let t = 0; t < 80; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, prng);
    expect(view[S.VEL_X]).toBe(0);
    expect(view[S.VEL_Y]).toBe(0);
  });

  it('WRAP: particles crossing the edge reappear on the opposite side', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = WORLD - 5;
      v[b + S.VEL_X] = 10;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.POS_X]).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(view[S.POS_X]).toBeLessThan(10);
  });

  it('WRAP gate: without WRAP, edges clamp and reflect at the WALL_REFLECT default', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = WORLD - 5;
      v[b + S.VEL_X] = 10;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    // GLOW with zero SIGNAL keeps the sim running without adding any force.
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.GLOW);
    for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.POS_X]).toBeLessThan(WORLD);        // clamped inside the world
    expect(view[S.VEL_X]).toBeCloseTo(-10, 5);        // full 100% reflect (default)
  });

  it('WRAP: WALL_REFLECT slider — 0 absorbs, 1 reflects, 2 doubles the bounce', () => {
    const run = (wallReflect) => {
      const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
        v[b + S.POS_X] = WORLD - 5;
        v[b + S.VEL_X] = 10;
      });
      const laws = createLawState();
      // GLOW with zero SIGNAL keeps the sim running without adding any force.
      set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.GLOW);
      const prev = runtimeConfig.worldParams;
      runtimeConfig.worldParams = { ...prev, WALL_REFLECT: wallReflect };
      for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
      runtimeConfig.worldParams = prev;
      return { x: view[S.POS_X], vx: view[S.VEL_X] };
    };
    const absorb = run(0);
    const reflect = run(1);
    const double = run(2);
    expect(absorb.x).toBeCloseTo(WORLD - 0.01, 3); // 100% absorption → sticks to wall
    expect(absorb.vx).toBeCloseTo(0, 5);
    expect(reflect.x).toBeCloseTo(WORLD - 2.5, 1); // full reflect → ~2.5 back in (clamped at WORLD-0.01)
    expect(reflect.vx).toBeCloseTo(-10, 5);
    // 200% reflect moves twice as far before the MAX_VELOCITY cap reins it in.
    expect(double.x).toBeLessThan(reflect.x - 1);
    expect(double.vx).toBeLessThan(0);
  });
});
````

### Source

````js
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { runtimeConfig } from '../../src/state/runtimeConfig.js';
import {
  PARTICLE_STRIDE, MAX_PARTICLES, STRIDE_INDEXES as S, DNA_RANGES, LAW_INDEXES,
} from '../../src/constants.js';
import { createParticleBuffer } from '../../src/state/particleBuffer.js';
import { createLawState, set, isSet } from '../../src/state/lawState.js';
import { createDNABuffer, loadDefaults } from '../../src/dna/dnaBuffer.js';
import { solve } from '../../src/physics/solver.js';

const WORLD = 2000;
const DT = 0.25;
const rng = () => 0.5;

function makeWorld(count, setup) {
  const buf = createParticleBuffer(MAX_PARTICLES, PARTICLE_STRIDE);
  const view = buf.view;
  const dna = createDNABuffer();
  loadDefaults(dna, DNA_RANGES);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const b = i * PARTICLE_STRIDE;
    view[b + S.POS_X] = 1000;
    view[b + S.POS_Y] = 1000;
    view[b + S.POS_Z] = 1000;
    view[b + S.VEL_X] = 0; view[b + S.VEL_Y] = 0; view[b + S.VEL_Z] = 0;
    view[b + S.MASS] = 1.5;
    view[b + S.SPECIES_ID] = 0;
    view[b + S.DEAD] = 0;
    view[b + S.AGE] = 0;
    view[b + S.ENERGY] = 100;
    view[b + S.SIGNAL] = 0;
    view[b + S.HUNGER] = 0;
    view[b + S.ARMOR] = 0;
    view[b + S.TEMPERATURE] = 0;
    view[b + S.RADIUS] = 0.6;
    view[b + S.MITOSIS_TIMER] = 0;
    view[b + S.PARTNER_ID] = -1;
    view[b + S.BOND_PARTNER_1] = -1;
    for (let d = 0; d < 42; d++) {
      const r = DNA_RANGES[d] || { min: -1, max: 1 };
      view[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + d] = r.default ?? 0;
    }
    if (setup) setup(view, dna, b, i);
  }
  return { view, dna };
}

describe('Batch 02 — COLL / ACCR / PLANETARY / LIFE (indices 4-7)', () => {
  it('COLL: approaching particles bounce — momentum exchange along the normal', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      if (i === 0) { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000; v[b + S.VEL_X] = 1; }
      else { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1002; v[b + S.VEL_X] = -1; }
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.COLL);
    expect(isSet(laws, LAW_INDEXES.COLL)).toBe(true);
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    // Closing speed (v_i − v_j = 2.0) must be reduced by the bounce impulse.
    const closing = view[S.VEL_X] - view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.VEL_X];
    expect(closing).toBeLessThan(2.0);
    // Pair must not have crossed: i stays left of j, near contact.
    const sep = view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.POS_X] - view[S.POS_X];
    expect(sep).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(sep).toBeLessThan(2.0);
  });

  it('COLL gate: without COLL, overlapping particles pass through each other', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      if (i === 0) { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000; v[b + S.VEL_X] = 1; }
      else { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1002; v[b + S.VEL_X] = -1; }
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    for (let t = 0; t < 20; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.POS_X] - view[S.POS_X]).toBeLessThan(0); // crossed
  });

  it('ACCR: a larger body absorbs mass from an overlapping smaller neighbour', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      if (i === 0) { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000; v[b + S.MASS] = 10; }
      else { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000.5; v[b + S.MASS] = 1.5; }
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.COLL);
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.ACCR);
    // FUSION_TIME DNA (17): 0 → sub-threshold pairs fuse on first contact
    // (proximity dwell is instantaneous).
    view[S.DNA_CACHE_START + 17] = 0;
    expect(isSet(laws, LAW_INDEXES.ACCR)).toBe(true);
    const mBig0 = view[S.MASS];
    const mSmall0 = view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.MASS];
    solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    const gained = view[S.MASS] - mBig0;
    const lost = mSmall0 - view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.MASS];
    expect(gained).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(lost).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(gained).toBeCloseTo(lost, 6); // mass conserved
  });

  it('ACCR gate: without ACCR, overlapping particles do not exchange mass', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      if (i === 0) { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000; v[b + S.MASS] = 10; }
      else { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000.5; v[b + S.MASS] = 1.5; }
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.COLL);
    solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.MASS]).toBe(10);
    expect(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.MASS]).toBe(1.5);
  });

  it('ACCR: FUSION_MOMENTUM is the MINIMUM momentum to fuse — fast pairs merge, slow pairs do not', () => {
    const run = (fusionMom) => {
      const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
        v[b + S.MASS] = i === 0 ? 10 : 1;
        v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 16] = fusionMom; // FUSION_MOMENTUM on both (each gates its own fusion)
        v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 17] = 1000; // FUSION_TIME: dwell path never triggers
        if (i === 0) {
          v[b + S.POS_X] = 999;
        } else {
          v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000;
          v[b + S.VEL_X] = -2; // 2.0 relative approach speed → 2.0 relative momentum
        }
      });
      const laws = createLawState();
      set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.ACCR);
      set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
      for (let t = 0; t < 1; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
      return view[S.MASS];
    };
    expect(run(0.5)).toBeGreaterThan(10);  // above min momentum → fuses
    expect(run(50)).toBe(10);              // below min momentum → bounces, no fusion
  });

  it('ACCR: FUSION_TIME — sub-threshold pairs fuse after dwelling in close proximity', () => {
    const run = (ticks) => {
      const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
        v[b + S.MASS] = i === 0 ? 10 : 1;
        v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 16] = 100; // FUSION_MOMENTUM: momentum path never triggers
        v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 17] = 3;   // FUSION_TIME: 3 seconds of proximity
        if (i === 0) v[b + S.POS_X] = 999;
        else v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000;
      });
      const laws = createLawState();
      set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.ACCR);
      set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
      for (let t = 0; t < ticks; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
      return view[S.MASS];
    };
    expect(run(11)).toBe(10);   // 11 × 0.25 = 2.75 s < 3 s → not yet fused
    expect(run(13)).toBeGreaterThan(10); // 13 × 0.25 = 3.25 s ≥ 3 s → fused
  });

  it('ACCR: sub-threshold ACCR-only contacts bounce instead of passing through', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      v[b + S.MASS] = i === 0 ? 10 : 1;
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 16] = 100; // below min momentum
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 17] = 1000; // dwell never completes
      if (i === 0) v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000;
      else { v[b + S.POS_X] = 1001; v[b + S.VEL_X] = -2; }
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.ACCR); // COLL off — bounce must come from ACCR itself
    solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.MASS]).toBe(10);                      // no fusion
    expect(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.MASS]).toBe(1);     // no fusion
    // Closing speed reduced by the sub-threshold elastic bounce.
    const closing = view[S.VEL_X] - view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.VEL_X];
    expect(closing).toBeLessThan(2.0);
  });

  it('PLANETARY: constant downward gravity pulls particles toward the ground (z → 0)', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = 100; v[b + S.POS_Y] = 100; v[b + S.POS_Z] = 100;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.PLANETARY);
    expect(isSet(laws, LAW_INDEXES.PLANETARY)).toBe(true);
    for (let t = 0; t < 200; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.POS_Z]).toBeLessThan(100);  // falling toward the ground
    expect(view[S.VEL_Z]).toBeLessThan(0);    // downward drift
    expect(view[S.POS_X]).toBe(100);          // no lateral drift
    expect(view[S.POS_Y]).toBe(100);
  });

  it('PLANETARY: gravity acceleration is mass-independent — heavy and light fall alike', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(2, (v, dna, b, i) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = 1000; v[b + S.POS_Y] = 1000; v[b + S.POS_Z] = 1000;
      v[b + S.MASS] = i === 0 ? 1 : 10;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.PLANETARY);
    for (let t = 0; t < 50; t++) solve(view, 2, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.VEL_Z]).toBeCloseTo(view[PARTICLE_STRIDE + S.VEL_Z], 6);
  });

  it('PLANETARY gate: without PLANETARY, no downward pull', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.POS_X] = 100; v[b + S.POS_Y] = 100; v[b + S.POS_Z] = 100;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    for (let t = 0; t < 200; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, DT, rng);
    expect(view[S.VEL_Z]).toBe(0);
    expect(view[S.POS_Z]).toBe(100);
  });

  it('LIFE: metabolic energy decay (ENERGY_EFFICIENCY=0 ⇒ −0.01/tick)', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 34] = 0; // ENERGY_EFFICIENCY
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 12] = 1e-6; // MUTATION → negligible bio-pulse noise
      v[b + S.ENERGY] = 100;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.LIFE);
    expect(isSet(laws, LAW_INDEXES.LIFE)).toBe(true);
    runtimeConfig.worldParams.LIGHT_LEVEL = 0; // isolate metabolic decay from photosynthesis
    for (let t = 0; t < 100; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, 1.0, rng);
    expect(view[S.ENERGY]).toBeLessThan(100);
    expect(view[S.ENERGY]).toBeCloseTo(99.0, 3);
    runtimeConfig.worldParams.LIGHT_LEVEL = 0.5; // restore default
  });

  it('LIFE: metabolic energy hitting 0 kills (energy-depletion death)', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 34] = 0; // ENERGY_EFFICIENCY → full decay
      v[b + S.DNA_CACHE_START + 12] = 1e-6; // negligible bio-pulse noise
      v[b + S.ENERGY] = 0.05; // barely above the metabolic floor
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.LIFE);
    runtimeConfig.worldParams.LIGHT_LEVEL = 0; // no photosynthesis subsidy
    for (let t = 0; t < 20; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, 1.0, rng);
    expect(view[S.DEAD]).toBe(1);
    runtimeConfig.worldParams.LIGHT_LEVEL = 0.5; // restore default
  });

  it('LIFE: starvation kills when HUNGER exceeds the cap', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.HUNGER] = 100;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.LIFE);
    solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, 1.0, rng);
    expect(view[S.DEAD]).toBe(1);
  });

  it('LIFE gate: without LIFE, energy is untouched', () => {
    const { view, dna } = makeWorld(1, (v, dna, b) => {
      v[b + S.ENERGY] = 100;
    });
    const laws = createLawState();
    set(laws, LAW_INDEXES.WRAP);
    for (let t = 0; t < 20; t++) solve(view, 1, PARTICLE_STRIDE, laws, dna, WORLD, 1.0, rng);
    expect(view[S.ENERGY]).toBe(100);
  });
});
````
